svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Harness reference architecture - the model is the only swappable layer
svg.desc: The harness drawn bottom-up in seven layers, plus a viewer band. L1 the work: the repository, the branches and the data. L2 the enforcement plane, the thickest band: the settings.json deny list, the PreToolUse hooks that exit 2, the tools allowlist, maxTurns, and the harness-toggle ledger that is the only supported way to switch a control off, all enforced by shell scripts and glob matching with no model consulted and proven by 93 guardrail eval cases per hook flavour. L3 the state plane: the master-plan board, the task files with their append-only session logs, the committed disabled.json ledger, and the machine-local run archive whose detail level and retention cap are chosen at intake. L4 the context plane: always-RAM of 7 unconditional rules and lazy-RAM of 9 path-scoped rules, 63 percent of the rule content, volatile and billed every turn. L5 the policy plane: 16 rules, the agent bodies and the data-classification table, advisory only. A red boundary line marks that everything below it is unchanged when you swap the model. L6 the model slot: a dashed socket holding the seat-tier bindings, judgment to opus, implementation to sonnet, mechanical to haiku, with a dashed not-built zone for other vendors. L7 orchestration, which runs on the model and fields a fitted roster rather than a fixed cast, because the long, tests, solo_review, db_engineer and db_seeder flags decide which seats exist. Below everything, a viewer band: the whole control plane is emitted as one deterministic file, .claude/state/harness-graph.json, and harness-view renders Flow, Graph, Assess and Master-plan views of it and scores the harness with no model in the loop.
svg.text: Harness reference architecture - the model is the only swappable layer
Drawn bottom-up. Each layer names who enforces it, and whether it survives a model swap.
L7 ORCHESTRATION
RUNS ON THE MODEL
enforced by: nobody. It is the sequence the orchestrator is asked to follow - a procedure, not a gate.
orchestrator routes -> spec-guardian locks the contract -> dev implements -> qa-test, if testing was chosen ->
code-reviewer + security-reviewer, or one merged reviewer under solo_review (gates, read-only) -> merge
The roster is FITTED, not fixed: the long, tests, solo_review, db_engineer and db_seeder flags decide which seats exist.
An agent's 'done' is a claim - verified against git and the session log, never taken on trust.
L6 THE MODEL SLOT
THE SWAPPABLE PART
Agents declare a seat tier; the tier binds to a model. model-policy.md holds that binding table.
SOLID - delivered: opus, sonnet and haiku are bound below. fable is accepted by model: but no seat binds it.
JUDGMENT -> opus
orchestrator, debugger,
merge-manager, and the gate:
the two reviewers, or reviewer
IMPLEMENTATION -> sonnet
the dev seats, qa-test, devops,
data-modeler, db-engineer,
ba-analyst, spec-guardian
MECHANICAL -> haiku
history-tracker (flag long or
audit), db-seeder (flag
db_seeder), sast-runner (audit)
DASHED - not built: other vendors, which would need an execution adapter.
Claude Code frontmatter accepts only opus | sonnet | haiku | fable. A vendor swap is a PORT, not a config change.
Tier is swappable. Vendor is not - see docs/ASSESSMENT.md, Gap 2.
Everything BELOW this line is unchanged when you swap the model
L5 POLICY PLANE - advisory
SURVIVES A MODEL SWAP
enforced by: nobody. It shapes behaviour. It is NOT a hard enforcement layer.
.claude/rules/ - 16 rules, 5 of them flag-gated | the agent bodies | the data-classification table
Public / Internal / Confidential / Restricted. Classification beats seat tier - a rule about data, not about a model.
L4 CONTEXT PLANE - volatile, budgeted
SURVIVES A MODEL SWAP
enforced by: the context window. Billed every turn. Lost on compaction.
Always-RAM: CLAUDE.md -> @AGENTS.md, 7 unconditional rules, the agent body, the tool schemas
Lazy-RAM: 9 path-scoped rules - loaded only on a matching file touch. 62% of the rule content.
L3 STATE PLANE - durable, on disk
SURVIVES A MODEL SWAP
enforced by: git. Committed markdown, written by the agent AS IT WORKS.
docs/tasks/master-plan.md - the board. One row per task: ID, owner, status.
docs/tasks/active/TASK-NNN.md - goal, acceptance criteria, decisions, and an append-only session log.
.claude/disabled.json - committed: which rule, command or hook is off, and why. A scaffold re-run respects it.
.claude/state/history/ - run archive, written by a hook on SubagentStop. Gitignored - machine-local.
detail full | summary | minimal | off, and a retention cap that keeps only the newest N run files.
Survives compaction, session end, a dead IDE. A fresh agent resumes from here.
L2 ENFORCEMENT PLANE - the reins
SURVIVES A MODEL SWAP
enforced by: shell scripts and glob matching. No model is consulted.
settings.json permissions.deny -> cannot SEE: .env, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa*, secrets/**, + your Restricted paths
PreToolUse hooks, exit 2 -> cannot DO: protect-secrets, guard-agent-spawn, guard-main-commit,
check-commit-msg, protect-adr. 11 hooks ship; guard-agent-scope advises, specs-reminder and agent-history record.
tools: allowlist -> cannot REACH: reviewers get Read, Grep, Glob, Bash - never Edit or Write
maxTurns -> the circuit breaker on a stuck agent: debugger 30, code-reviewer 25, history-tracker 10
/harness-toggle -> the only way off: files move to .claude/disabled/, and disabled.json records what and why
python eval/guardrail_eval.py -> 107/107 per hook flavour. No model is in the loop, so nothing depends on one.
L1 THE WORK
SURVIVES A MODEL SWAP
The repository, the branches, the data. What every layer above exists to protect.
The one thing here the harness cannot regenerate.
THE VIEW - .claude/state/harness-graph.json + harness-view
NO MODEL IN THE LOOP
Every layer above becomes a node in one deterministic file: agents, rules, commands, hooks, settings, scripts, modules, tasks.
harness-view renders Flow, Graph, Assess and Master-plan views of it, and scores the harness against this skill's own
quality gate - a plain rules engine, no network, exit 1 on a high finding, so a browser and a CI job cannot disagree.
deterministic - enforced by the harness
model / advisory
artifact - file on disk
dashed - volatile, or not built
